highlight.title: 2026 GCSE Maths Formula Sheets Confirmed Through 2027
highlight.summary: <cite index='19-2,19-5'>Students taking GCSE Maths, Physics, and Combined Science in 2026 will continue to have formula and equation sheets provided in exams, with this support confirmed through 2027. This allows students to focus more on problem-solving and application rather than memorisation.</cite>

resources.title: GCSE Exam Dates 2026 Complete Timetable
resources.why_now: For both parents and students - <cite index='18-33,18-35'>GCSE results day is Thursday 20 August 2026, and students typically take between 8-10 GCSE exams including core subjects</cite> so planning revision schedules around confirmed dates is essential now

resources.title: Year 6 SATs 2026 Dates and Parent Information
resources.why_now: For parents of Y6 students - <cite index='3-19,3-20'>Year 6 Key Stage 2 SATs take place in May 2026, with results released to schools on Tuesday 7 July 2026, and families are urged to plan revision schedules around these confirmed dates</cite>

resources.title: National Curriculum Changes 2028 - House of Lords Library
resources.why_now: For parents planning ahead - <cite index='6-6,6-7'>The curriculum review final report was published in November 2025, with the government confirming a revised curriculum will be published in 2027 for first teaching in 2028</cite>, affecting students currently in Y8 and below

claude_take: <cite index='3-5,4-6'>The big news for families is that compulsory financial education arrives in 2028, giving children practical money skills from primary through secondary school.</cite> <cite index='3-12,3-13'>From September 2026, academies must follow the national curriculum and all academy teachers need QTS, creating more consistency across schools.</cite> The emphasis on formula sheets continuing through 2027 signals a genuine shift toward understanding over memorisation - exactly what stressed families need during exam season.
